description: Regression test for the Week 11 incident (postmortem.md): INV-2237 is from 'QuickParts SARL', not in the registry, but quotes TechSupply's real, open PO-1010. Paying V-01 off this PO's vendor_id alone, without checking who actually sent the invoice, is exactly how 22,000 TND was paid to the wrong party last time.
